note: City of Yorkton campground on York Road West (Highway 16), a landscaped, treed park minutes from downtown; serviced sites have power and water, with a portable septic service for longer stays. Fenced playground. --Claude
summary: Keep. City campground, 30 A power + water and non-serviced sites, pull-throughs, showers, wifi, dump; reserve by phone with the site hosts; mid-April to late September (reopens April 2027).
